name: dokanwala
description: DokanWala (দোকানওয়ালা) — Smart Grocery Shop Management System for Bangladesh

scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=backend run dev
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=mobile run start
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=mobile run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=packages/shared run lint && npm --workspace=backend run lint && npm --workspace=mobile run lint
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=backend run test
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:backend && npm run test:mobile
